# uint8 is modelled as int in the range 0..255; k is the rotation count in 0..7.

def rotl8(x: int, k: int) -> int:
    """Rotate the 8-bit value x left by k bits, wrapping the high bits to the low end."""
    pre 0 <= x and x <= 255
    pre 0 <= k and k <= 7
    post 0 <= out and out <= 255
    post (((out << ((8 - k) % 8)) | (out >> k)) & 0xFF) == x
    ex rotl8(0x81, 1) == 0x03
    ex rotl8(0x80, 1) == 0x01
    ex rotl8(0x0F, 4) == 0xF0
    ex rotl8(0x12, 0) == 0x12
    return ((x << k) | (x >> (8 - k))) & 0xFF
